item.title: Diver certification raffle raises funds for LEMA dive team
item.description: Lauderdale County residents interested in scuba diving have an opportunity to earn their certification for just $5 as the Lauderdale County Emergency Management Agency/ Meridian Fire Department raffles off a PADI Open Water Certification diving course.

item.title: Drug Task Force makes narcotics arrest following search warrant
item.description: The East Mississippi Drug Task Force made one arrest Friday following a search warrant as part of a narcotics investigation.

item.title: Willie sentenced to 13 years for fatal DUI crash
item.description: District Attorney Kassie Coleman announced Monday the guilty plea and sentencing of a Braxton Jacolbee Willie, 32, for aggravated DUI causing death in connection with the death of Ms. Janan Rush.

item.title: Allred represents Realtors at state Capitol
item.description: Mississippi Association of Realtors Executive Committee member Tim Allred met with Sen. Jeff Tate at the state Capitol on Thursday, Feb. 26, for Realtor’s Day at the Capitol.

item.title: College & Career Fair opens opportunities for Ross Collins students
item.description: Ross Collins Career and Technical Center hosted its 2026 College & Career Fair on Friday, Feb. 27, in the Meridian High School Gym, welcoming students for a morning of opportunity, exploration and connection.

item.title: Meridian Public School District wins Leadership in Governance Award
item.description: The Meridian Public School District was honored with the prestigious Leadership in Governance Award during the Celebration Luncheon at the Mississippi School Boards Association Annual Conference on Feb. 25.

item.title: Meridian council approves Intellisafe contract to tackle school zone speeding
item.description: Drivers failing to abide by school zone speed limits may soon pay a price after the Meridian City Council on Tuesday voted to approve a contract with Intellisafe to use radar guns at locations throughout the city.
